title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open model for Apple silicon
excerpt: Meta has introduced Muse Spark Open, a new open-weight AI model designed to run locally on Mac computers.
body_html:
Meta has announced the launch of its newest artificial intelligence model, named Muse Spark Open. Developed in collaboration with Apple, this open-weight model is designed to operate locally on devices powered by Apple silicon.

By running directly on Mac hardware, users can execute the AI model locally without relying entirely on cloud-based infrastructure. The release marks a collaboration between the social media giant and Apple to support local AI processing capabilities on Mac computers.
